name: Quintanavides (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally white over blue with a red triangle at the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Quintanavides (a castle, a cloud, a horse's head and a Moor's head).
history: Municipal flag of Quintanavides; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
